description: MCP server connecting your Zotero library to Claude and other AI assistants (search, cite, summarize, semantic search). Installs the PyPI package 'zotero-mcp-server' (54yyyu); the command is 'zotero-mcp'.
notes: The fixed 'url'/'hash' below (the shared installer script, pinned at tag v0.1.0) exist only to satisfy Scoop's per-architecture install check; the real install is done by uv in pre_install and the downloaded file is unused. It never changes across versions, so autoupdate only bumps 'version'.
